_note: Which party held the majority of each chamber, by date. A committed reference table, not derived from terms.json: roster counts include mid-Congress replacements and caucusing independents, so a raw count can mislabel the majority (e.g. the 110th Senate is 51-51 on the roster). `from`/`to` are inclusive ISO dates; `to` null = current. Every chamber's rows are contiguous from 1991-01-03. Validated against roster counts (loosely) by lib/congress-control.test.ts.

sources.senate: U.S. Senate, Party Division in the Senate, 1789-Present, https://www.senate.gov/history/partydiv.htm (control by date, incl. the 2001 and 2021 mid-Congress changes; fetched 2026-10-01)
sources.house: U.S. House of Representatives, History, Art & Archives, Party Divisions of the House of Representatives, https://history.house.gov/Institution/Party-Divisions/Party-Divisions/ (fetched 2026-10-01)
